title: Friday Pub Quiz at The Anchor

lines.intro: Evening, quizzers! Phones out, names in, and no googling: I can see you.
reveal: Let's see who knew that one.
lines.final: That's the lot! Give it up for our winners.

rounds.title: The 90s
rounds.intro: Round one: the 1990s. Cast your mind back to dial-up.

questions.text: Which band released the album "Definitely Maybe" in 1994?

source.quote: Definitely Maybe is the debut studio album by English rock band Oasis, released on 29 August 1994

questions.text: Which footballer won the Ballon d'Or in 1998?
questions.reveal_line: Zizou! Half points if you only remembered the headbutt.

questions.text: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?

source.quote: The fall of the Berlin Wall on 9 November 1989

questions.text: Where did your quizmaster take this holiday photo?

picture.alt: A tall iron lattice tower over a river

source.quote: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.
